title: Center-Manifold Reduction of Learning at Bifurcations: Interference and Rich Learning in Recurrent Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2605.12763v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Rich learning in recurrent neural networks often proceeds through sudden transitions in latent dynamics, but there is little theory predicting how gradient descent behaves during these events. We study the local learning geometry near codimension-one bifurcations through the global empirical Neural Tangent Kernel (GeNTK). Under local center-manifold conditions, and when bifurcation-related sensitivity dominates bounded residual terms, we show that the global parameter-to-state Jacobian \(D_\theta h\) is approximated by a low-rank normal-form operator. The induced GeNTK and Fisher information matrix therefore become strongly amplified and anisotropic, concentrating toward a rank-one channel for the four scalar codimension-one bifurcations and a rank-two real channel for a Neimark--Sacker bifurcation. Controlled high-dimensional RNN experiments validate this operator reduction. In learned RNNs, the same low-rank concentration coincides

translated_title: 分岔处学习的中心流形约简：递归神经网络中的干扰与丰富学习
translated_abstract: 递归神经网络中的丰富学习通常通过潜在动力学的突然转变进行，但关于梯度下降在这些事件中如何表现的预测理论很少。我们通过全局经验神经正切核（GeNTK）研究余维一分岔附近的局部学习几何。在局部中心流形条件下，当与分岔相关的敏感性主导有界残差项时，我们证明全局参数到状态雅可比矩阵 \(D_\theta h\) 可由低秩规范形算子近似。由此产生的GeNTK和Fisher信息矩阵因此被强烈放大并呈各向异性，对于四个标量余维一分岔集中到秩一通道，对于Neimark-Sacker分岔集中到秩二实通道。受控高维RNN实验验证了这种算子约简。在学习到的RNN中，相同的低秩集中现象与这些事件同时发生。
tldr: 该论文通过中心流形约简和GeNTK分析，揭示了递归神经网络在分岔点附近的梯度下降学习几何可被低秩算子近似，导致学习动态集中到低秩通道，从而解释了丰富学习中的干扰现象。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that near bifurcations in recurrent neural networks, the gradient descent learning geometry can be approximated by low-rank operators via center-manifold reduction and GeNTK analysis, causing learning dynamics to concentrate into low-rank channels, which explains interference during rich learning.
